headline: Six Flags 🏰 SHUTS 🚪 DOWN X2 🎢 After 100+ 🧠 BRAIN 💥 INJURIES
text:
SIX FLAGS 🏰 MAGIC 🪄 MOUNTAIN just dropped 💣 the ultimate 🍆 CLIMAX on their spinning 🌀 X2 rollercoaster 🎢 after HUNDREDS 🙌 of riders got their BRAINS 🧠 absolutely RAILROADED 💥 by those 360° 🌀 seats that whip 🏋️ your skull around like a cheap 🍑 spin cycle!! The beast 🐺 has been SHUT 🚪 since July 🌞 after more than ONE HUNDRED 📈 lawsuits and reports claimed catastrophic 🏥 brain injuries from the ride that was supposed to be a THRILL 🌟 but left folks needing EMERGENCY 🚨 brain surgery 🧬 instead!! Park president 🧔 Brian Oerding came out swinging 🥊 saying "Ride safety 🛡️ is our cornerstone" while stroking 🖐️ that corporate 🍆 ego and admitting GUEST CONFIDENCE 😟 was getting absolutely COOKED 🔥 so they had to retire the ride because it was "the right thing to do" according to their own press release 📜!!

DORDICK LAW FIRM ⚖️ who filed the civil suits got hit up by nearly FOUR HUNDRED 📞 people claiming X2 left them with life-ruining 🧠 brain injuries after they hopped on expecting a WILD RIDE 🐎 but instead got their heads scrambled 🍳 like breakfast!! "They got on X2 expecting a thrill 🌟 instead they left with catastrophic brain injuries" the firm DROPPED 💦 in their statement while noting some victims needed emergency 🏥 brain surgery and others are still fighting 🥊 to get their lives back together after the spinning seats 🪑 absolutely demolished their confidence!! The law firm clapped back 🗣️ saying the permanent closure 🚫 comes "too late" for their clients who already got railed 💥 by this so-called thrill machine 🎢 that Six Flags kept running despite the red flags 🚩 waving like crazy!!

ORIGINALLY CALLED X 🅧 when it first opened 🎉 in 2002 the ride got SHUT DOWN 🔒 months later for major design flaws 🛠️ that had it looking like a broken 🍆 according to the LA Times report 📝 then it got yanked again in 2007 to swap out the trains for lighter versions before reopening as the rebranded X2 that has since been ridden by over SIXTEEN MILLION 🧮 people!! Yet despite passing all those safety tests 🧪 the park finally listened to the screams 😱 and decided to retire this spinning menace 🌀 permanently after the brain injury allegations stacked higher than the wait times ⏳ that used to have guests lining up for hours just to get their heads spun into next week!! Brian Oerding and the Six Flags crew 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 are now out here claiming they take guest confidence seriously but the law firms are side-eyeing 👀 hard saying this move does NOTHING for the people already hurt by this ride that kept operating like it was built different 🏗️ when clearly it wasn't!!

THE FAMILY 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 of 22-year-old Christopher Hawley who tragically DIED ☠️ after riding X2 in 2022 through Wisner Baum law firm dropped a statement saying they're "relieved" 😮‍💨 to hear Six Flags is finally closing the dangerous coaster 🎢 but it doesn't change the fact that Christopher was KILLED 💀 by a ride that was allowed to operate for nearly TWO DECADES 🕰️ despite all the warning signs!! Their wrongful death suit was settled with the park back in August 📅 yet attorney Brent Wisner made it crystal clear that "that tragedy cannot be undone" and called for legal reform 📜 proactive regulation and proper governmental oversight because we cannot rely on profit-centered corporations 🏦 to do the right thing only after enough people have been hurt!! He added that they hope whatever replaces the X2 is actually safe 🛡️ this time instead of another brain-rattling nightmare 🌀 that leaves riders down bad 🥴 with injuries no thrill should ever cause!!

SIX FLAGS 🏰 is now permanently retiring this spinning 🌀 death trap after the mountain of lawsuits and horror stories finally forced their hand but the damage is already done with over a hundred alleged brain injuries and at least one confirmed death that no amount of corporate statements 📢 can spin away!! The X2 which used to be the main attraction with those long wait times ⏳ and 360 degree seats that whipped your head like a blender 🥤 has now been put to bed 🛌 for good leaving the park to figure out what to build next that won't turn guests into plaintiffs ⚖️ overnight!! From the initial design flaws in 2002 all the way through 16 million rides later the ride finally got the axe 🔨 because enough brains got scrambled that even Six Flags had to admit the thrill wasn't worth the hospital bills 🏥 anymore!!
